_comment: FTR-TRC-003, ADR-TRC-008 (DEC-TRC-032): the checks of the quality scorecard, their risk weights, the grade thresholds and the attention threshold. Read by scripts/scorecard.py; change a number here, never in the code.

checks.title: Requirements covered
checks.rule: Every requirement is cited by a source file, directly or through a decision, task, ADR or plan linked to it.

checks.title: IDs defined
checks.rule: Every ID cited by the process or the sources is defined in the index.

checks.title: Requirements tasked
checks.rule: Every requirement is cited by a task of a plan.

checks.title: Tasks with a requirement
checks.rule: Every task cites at least one requirement itself.

checks.title: ADRs with a requirement
checks.rule: Every ADR, or one of its decisions, cites at least one requirement.

checks.title: Containers not empty
checks.rule: Every feature holds requirements, every ADR decisions and every plan tasks.

checks.title: Elements connected
checks.rule: Every element is cited by, or cites, something other than the element that contains it.

checks.title: Source files traced
checks.rule: Every scanned source file cites at least one ID.

checks.title: Functions traced
checks.rule: Every function cites an ID in its lines or in the comment just above it. Informational: it counts for nothing in the overall score.
